messages.subject: not executable question
messages.body_plain:
Dear development team,
Soory to interrupt you right now. I have intsalled irace on Windows for several days , and I met a problem that each time I execute irace it produces error like below:
 == irace == target runner 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.4.1/library/irace/templates/tunning/target-runner' is not executable
i looked for the user guide but only found the resolution of Linux. and I really want to know how to make the file executable under Window.I really appreciate for reply.Thank you for your kindly help.
Best Regards
Zhenxi Xia

messages.subject: Re: not executable question
messages.body_plain:
Dear Zhenxi Xia,

To make some file executable in Windows, follow the instructions here or similar instructions for your version of Windows: https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb727008.aspx

However, the file templates/target-runner.tmpl is not for windows. The version for windows is called templates/target-runner-windows.tmpl

An alternative is to make your program accept command-line parameters as provided by irace and return the output expected by irace. This way, your executable will be the target-runner and you don't need any additional files.

Cheers,

Manuel.

messages.subject: Re: What is the purpose of default.txt?
messages.subject_clean: What is the purpose of default.txt?
messages.body_plain:
Hello Daniel,

The default.txt file corresponds to the definition of the initial configurations (in the user guide). The initial configurations file should contain one or more configurations (assignment of parameter values for tour algorithm) that are used to start the search of parameters.

Let us know if you have more questions,

Leslie.
